# XNB Version 4 Sample

`LogoOnly_64px.png` is distributed in the MonoGame repository at
`Tests/Assets/Textures/LogoOnly_64px.png` under the Microsoft Public License.
The matching license is in `LICENSE-MonoGame.txt`.

`LogoOnly_64px-v4.xnb` was produced from that image by the independent
ImageToXNB tool. Its README identifies the output as XNA Framework 3.1 / XNB
version 4. The tool source and executable are not part of Peare.
